Container.Name: Energietracker
Container.Overview: Energy and water tracker for your home: meter readings, supply contracts, monthly advance payments, annual bills, weather-adjusted analysis and forecasts for electricity, gas, water, district heating, heating oil, pellets and PV. A web app (PWA) in seven languages. No database: all data stays as JSON files in the appdata folder. Home Assistant can push meter readings automatically and read balances back. Built for your own network; switch on the built-in sign-in (ET_AUTH) before you expose it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface. Change the host port if 8080 is in use; the container always listens on 80.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: All data (meters, readings, contracts, settings, snapshots) as JSON files. Keep this path stable and include it in your backups. On first start the container makes it writable for its web server user.

Config.Name: Log level (ET_LOG_LEVEL)
Config.Description: debug, info, warning or error. debug also logs every request.

Config.Name: Sign-in mode (ET_AUTH)
Config.Description: Optional. off, password or proxy. Empty = switchable in the app (Settings → Access). ET_AUTH=off is also the way back in after a forgotten password.

Config.Name: Admin password hash (ET_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH)
Config.Description: Optional. Password as a PHP password_hash() value; fixes the password so it cannot be changed in the app.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies (ET_TRUSTED_PROXIES)
Config.Description: Optional. Addresses or CIDR ranges of your reverse proxy (comma-separated). Only requests from there may set the user header in proxy mode.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts (ET_ALLOWED_HOSTS)
Config.Description: Optional. Comma-separated host names the app answers to, *.example.org allowed (protection against DNS rebinding). IP addresses and localhost always work. Empty = all.

Config.Name: Frame ancestors (ET_FRAME_ANCESTORS)
Config.Description: Optional. Origins allowed to embed the app, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123 for a Home Assistant webpage card.
